selection.criterion: Worst stratum within 2.5 percentage points of best; then overall score and fewer caps; starting policy eligible

notes: Test seeds were not used for training or checkpoint selection.
Balanced scores give equal family, campaign/map, route/objective and opponent/recruiter mass.
CSV and heatmap percentages are raw rates within each row.
Campaign caps count as failures and have terminal reward -1.
Only the planner is learned; recruiter and campaigner remain existing game algorithms.
